title: Affine sheaf-level derived edge normalized by the right-derived unit
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings, phi : B → A, f = Spec(phi), and i an integer, with the scheme-module derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. There exists a natural transformation epsilon : f_* H^i → H^i Rf_* on D_QCoh(Spec A) [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every additive exact functor F from A-modules to modules on Spec A with quasi-coherent values such that f_* F is exact, every cochain complex C, and every proof that Q(F C) belongs to D_QCoh, the composite f_*F(H^i C) → f_*H^i(Q(F C)) → H^i(Rf_* Q(F C)), using inverse exact-homology and Q/homology comparisons then epsilon, equals the inverse exact-homology comparison for f_*F, the inverse Q/homology comparison, and homology of the actual right-derived unit on F C. The conclusion is independent of an ordinary tilde comparison or any tilde/Gamma coordinate map.

source.place: 0AVW, proof, cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison, applied on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: Direct image is additive and left exact: its composite with the faithful limit-reflecting module-sheaf forgetful functor is restriction of presheaves along the map on opens. Register enough injectives for module sheaves. Prove ordinary affine direct-image acyclicity in the private helper affineDirectImage_rightAcyclic: quasi-coherent modules are Cech-acyclic on affine opens by exactAt_cechComplex_basicOpen; injective module sheaves are flasque and hence Cech-acyclic; the class is stable under cokernels in short exact sequences by the sectionwise Cech argument. For a short exact sequence starting in this class, surjective_app_of_cechAcyclicOnAffines lifts sections on inverse images of affine opens. The affine basis and epi_of_forall_exists_app_eq make pushforward of the quotient epi. Apply the proved generic rightAcyclic_of_epi_map_g dimension-shifting criterion. Convert positive integer degrees to natural successor degrees and transport this vanishing with homologyRightDerivedFunctorObjSingleFunctorIso. This supplies the acyclicity premise of the unbounded quasi-coherent comparison without importing the cyclic AffineMorphism module.

Let gamma be H^i Rf_* applied to the canonical lower-truncation projection at i, restricted to D_QCoh. The lower truncation still has quasi-coherent homology: the surviving degrees are identified with the original homology and the remaining degrees are zero. The quasi-coherent object property contains the zero free sheaf on the empty set. The ordinary H^i of this projection is invertible; the natural affine derived cohomology comparison transfers this invertibility to gamma. Thus gamma is a natural isomorphism.

Apply the generic normalized bottom-comparison theorem to f_* to obtain delta: H^i Rf_* tau_GE_i → f_* H^i. Define epsilon to be delta inverse followed by gamma inverse, both restricted to D_QCoh. For an exact F and complex C, apply the bottom-unit equation to the left homology data of C mapped by F and by F followed by f_*. Their cycle inclusions agree, so the cycle comparison is the identity. Postcompose the equation by delta inverse and gamma inverse and cancel their identities. The quotient (F followed by f_*)(pi) is epi because the composite preserves homology. Cancel this epi and expand mapHomologyIso. This is exactly the stated equality with the actual right-derived unit.

proof_origin.place: 05TC (2), upper truncation of the lower-truncated object; the degree-zero left-exact comparison and its unit, as used in 08D4 with bound one and in the 0AVW cohomology display.
proof_origin.note: Lean reduction via invertibility of the derived lower-truncation projection and a generic normalized bottom comparison. Cycle-to-homology cancellation is proved inline.

theorem exists_affineDerivedPushforwardSheafEdge
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) (i : ℤ) :
  ∃ ε : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) i ⋙
      RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom ⟶
    (schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))).ι ⋙
      schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i,
    ∀ (F : ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
      [F.Additive] [F.PreservesZeroMorphisms] [F.PreservesHomology]
      [(F ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
      [(F ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesHomology]
      (_hF : ∀ M, (F.obj M).IsQuasicoherent)
      (C : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (hC : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C))),
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).map
          (((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso F).inv ≫
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ i).app
              ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)).inv) ≫
        ε.app ⟨_, hC⟩ =
      ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso
        (F ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom)).inv ≫
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ i).app
          (((F ⋙ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom)
              |>.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)).inv ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i).map
          (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit).app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
